## CodeROI AI instructions (managed - do not edit)

This repository participates in CodeROI attribution. Before you write code,
commit, open a pull request, or record a review action here, load the current
CodeROI session instructions by running:

    coderoi skill render coderoi-ai

Read that output directly in this session and follow it: it is the single
source of truth for how CodeROI attribution works in this repo. The instructions
print to stdout only -- keep them in memory and never save them to a file. This
file is just a pointer; it deliberately carries no procedure, so always render
for the current instructions rather than relying on anything cached here. No
source code or prompt text is sent by `coderoi bootstrap`.
